steps.text: Go down the ramp into the cellar south-west of Edron castle.
steps.source: Go down into the Edron Orc Cave. The entrance is southwest of the castle (Mapper Coords 129.149, 124.156, 7).

steps.text: Pull the lever if the stones block the way into the orc cave.
steps.source: You can access this area through a drain in the basement of the Edron Flats. (On the 7.1 map the cellar has a lever and stones that close the way.)

steps.text: Follow the cave west and south and go down (orcs, orc spearmen, orc warriors, poison spiders).
steps.source: Once in the hole, you will meet only Poison Spiders, Orcs, Orc Spearmen and Orc Warriors. Follow the cave to the west and then south.

steps.text: Go west and down again (orc warriors, orc spearmen, poison spiders).
steps.source: On this floor you will encounter Poison Spiders, Orcs, Orc Spearmen, Orc Warriors and probably one or two lured Orc Berserkers.

steps.text: Go down again (orc warriors and an orc berserker).
steps.source: Once down this hole you will face Orc Berserkers, Poison Spiders and Orc Warriors.

steps.text: Careful: orc berserkers right at the bottom. Go south into the last room: orc berserkers, 2 orc leaders and orc warriors.
steps.source: Right after going down the hole, you will encounter 3 - 5 Orc Berserkers. As you head south into the final room, you will have to face 3+ Orc Berserkers, 2 Orc Leaders and 2-3 Orc Warriors.
